reviews.title: Tracking me!!!???
reviews.text:
Why the hell is this app passing my location to other companies!!???

That is so out of order!! Why does every app these days spy on our lives??

I’m a doctor - I only treat people. I don’t then pass their private information to a long line of people offering to pay for it. It’s unbelievable. This is a weather app AND WE PAY YOU FOR IT!!! SO JUST GIVE US THE WEATHER!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: More interested in giving you ads than the weather that is very inaccurate anyway so it’s a delete!
reviews.text: Far better weather apps out there

reviews.title: Hate the colors they use!
reviews.text: They use the blue for the rain I guess and the background looks like sand. I don’t know why they didn’t stick with what everybody else uses -  green for rain, yellow for the more intense stuff and red for very heavy rain. Very difficult to figure out what is actually coming at you. I’m also finding that it’s not as accurate as others. Really disappointed as severe weather is pretty common in Dallas so you really like to know what the weather is. I didn’t find this map helpful at all. Way too weird looking.

reviews.title: Weather radar map
reviews.text: Why are you still promoting this app? When you try to use the map, the screen is blocked by a message saying that this version of the app is no longer supported.

reviews.title: UX getting more and more busy
reviews.text: Really not a fan of the recent UX changes. The developers seem to think more is better. There is now a lot of distracting movement on the top screen when using the slider. The large text block is very frustrating as it's so prominent. There should be an option to remove it for those who prefer a more visual interface. I understand text is important for screen readers, but making it optional would cater for all audiences.

reviews.title: Scams
reviews.text: The weather forecasting is good, but many of the links are to scam websites using lies to defraud victims. I understand the site needs advertising to pay for the service, but please couldn’t we stick to legal advertisements?

reviews.title: Disappointing it stopped working
reviews.text: I have an old iphone which works great, but today my favourite weather app has completely stopped working on it and says it needs me to buy a newer iPhone to work. That is extremely disappointing!

reviews.title: Ugly!
reviews.text: I couldn't get past the ugly design to see how well it works.  Bad looking app!

reviews.title: Update app not working
reviews.text: Latest update June 2026 widget not showing anything this is one of the best weather apps until this update. I will update my review when it’s fixed

reviews.title: What happened to the weather? AI ADVERTISING HAPPENED!
reviews.text:
This used to be so good. For at least 5 years it was my go-to for local weather reports. I’m a professional sailor… so local weather is a job requirement!

There used to be advertising that was none invasive. Acceptable. 
I’m not expecting quality apps to do it for free!
But since ‘updates’ started in January, 2025, it’s truly awful.
Now… ‘updates’? 
They aren’t updates for the app… they are updating to accommodate ever more advertising.
It’s constant… rarely do I see the next 2 hours weather without an advertisement.
But worse… it crashes ALL THE TIME.
Now… this is a German app.
So I know exactly what’s going on… the advertising AI is selecting advertisers on location.
And it’s the advert that’s causing the crash, not the app per se.
I wonder if the problem exists in Germany and the EU?
Anyway, my patience ran out.
It’s goodbye from me.
👋

reviews.title: Free Version No Go For Me
reviews.text:
The free version interface is more simplistic than advertised but gets the job done. However, the continuous ads that run at the bottom of each page are too obnoxious and intrusive. The devs need to rethink or pay attention to the content of the ads that are shown on their app. 

The ads depict nudity, sexual enticement, toys for male enhancement, and more.   Now, I can ignore these ads at the bottom of the page but when they pop up Full Page that’s where I draw the line. There does not appear to be any way to close them short of closing the app. This type of inducement will Not persuade me to buy the paid version.  So, bye bye. Deleted. 

Note:  I see the previous “most helpful “ reviews were 2-3 yrs old. Nothing more current showing. Wonder if anyone else has posted more recently and wonder if my review will be shown…..
